reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness with web search through Token Rhythm's OpenAI Responses API web_search tool, using a configured credential and returning source URLs.

summaries.zh: 通过 Token Rhythm 的 OpenAI Responses API web_search 工具为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索，并返回搜索过程中打开的来源链接。
summaries.en: Adds web search to DeepSeek Harness through Token Rhythm's OpenAI Responses API web_search tool and returns URLs opened during retrieval.

capabilities: Performs web searches through an OpenAI-compatible Responses API gateway

Returns opened-page URLs as source links
